text: Hi, I’m Katie. Here’s a quick tour of your Tringg dashboard.
This is your overview: today’s bookings, pending requests, calls handled, and your no-show rate.
Your agent Sofie is live. Call this number any time to try her yourself.
Recent calls appear here, each with a short AI summary.
Now the most important part: pending requests. When a caller books by phone, Sofie sends the request here for your approval. This one is from Neenasha, for four guests.
Confirm or decline it right here, or open the full reservation inbox.
In the inbox, open the request to see the date, time, party size, and how it came in.
Confirm to book the table, hold it while you check, or decline it. Respond before the timer ends, or the request expires.
Requests nobody answers move to Expired, alongside Today and Declined.
And filter by status, date, or party size.
Calls lists every conversation, with totals and your capture rate.
Filter by outcome. Completed. Transferred. FAQ. And Failed.
Open any call for an AI summary, tags for what the caller wanted, and the details Sofie captured.
Scroll down to play the recording and read the full transcript.
Agents is where you manage Sofie: her name, greeting, and voice. Right now, she speaks in my voice.
Everything else lives in Settings, from your profile menu.
Use the outlet switcher to move between outlets. Settings apply per outlet.
Basic info holds your address, map location, and timezone.
Hours and booking rules set when Sofie takes reservations, including special dates and closures.
FAQ and knowledge is what Sofie answers from. Open any question to edit it.
And Billing shows your plan and what’s included.
That’s your Tringg dashboard. Thanks for watching.
